title: Neural Surrogate Solver for Casimir Effect
prompt: Write a complete PyTorch implementation of a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) surrogate solver for calculating the Casimir effect force between non-parallel conductive plates. Include loss functions incorporating boundary conditions of vacuum quantum fluctuations and stress-energy tensor calculations.

title: FastAPI Production Backend
prompt: Implement a production-grade FastAPI web backend with asynchronous SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM, JWT authentication, rate-limiting middleware, background worker queues via Celery/Redis, and OpenAPI documentation.

title: Explanation of Casimir Effect
prompt: Explain the Casimir effect from first principles of Quantum Electrodynamics (QED). Derive the zero-point energy summation over vacuum photon modes between parallel conducting plates using zeta function regularization.

title: History of Armenia
prompt: Provide a comprehensive historical analysis of Armenia from the Urartu civilization and Kingdom of Armenia under Tigranes the Great through Medieval Bagratid era to modern statehood in the 20th and 21st centuries.

title: Analysis of The Picture of Dorian Gray
prompt: Provide a deep literary and philosophical analysis of Oscar Wilde's 'The Picture of Dorian Gray'. Discuss aestheticism vs hedonism, the Faustian bargain archetype, and the symbolism of the deteriorating portrait.
